title: Formal Resurgence and Differential Transcendence in Lean 4 (stokes-vandermonde)
description: Lean 4 formalization of the Borel–Stokes–Vandermonde criterion and unconditional machine-checked proofs of differential transcendence across analytic number theory, combinatorics, special functions, and mathematical physics. Version 3.0.0 adds: the quasipolynomial Euler-product parity theorem for arbitrary period M >= 1 (nonzero odd part implies D-transcendence over C(q) for both Lambert series and literal infinite Bose–Euler products); the complete IFF converse for periods M = 1 and M = 2 via formal Ramanujan ODEs; unconditional 3-tuple joint differential independence over C(q) of MacMahon's M(q), parts ≡ 1 mod 5, and parts ≡ 2 mod 5; the all-dimension free conformal scalar parity theorem on S^s for every s >= 2 (D-algebraic iff s is odd); relativistic ideal gas dimensional parity, unconditional 1D/3D Bose and Fermi equations of state P(ε) and squared sound speeds c_s^2(ε), and massive Casimir parity; Mordell, Eichler, and Stieltjes integral D-transcendence (and 5-tuple joint independence) over C(u); and a standalone Statements/ audit specification directory with per-family scope notes. All 80 audited declarations depend strictly on standard axioms ([propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]) and pass fresh leanchecker replay. Prime-number-theorem inputs use MediumPNT from PrimeNumberTheoremAnd (PNT+) by Alex Kontorovich, Terence Tao, and contributors. Google Gemini, OpenAI Codex, and Anthropic Claude assisted with the investigation, auditing, drafting, and Lean formalization. Independent specialist review is welcome.
